title: QC HAPPENINGS: Whitewater River Jam, SC Strawberry Festival, RiverFest and more - NewsBreak
text:
By Arri Woodhouse No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
CHARLOTTE, N.C. ( QUEEN CITY NEWS ) — Discover the best events happening in and around the Charlotte area, from festivals to live concerts; there’s something for everybody. Don’t miss out!
FRIDAY, MAY 1 South Carolina Strawberry Festival
The beloved South Carolina Strawberry Festival returns to the Town of Fort Mill. The festival is held in Walter Elisha Park at the Fort Mill Amphitheater. The pre-festival events started on April 17, including the pageants, Strawberry Festival Golf Tournament, Strawberry Sprint and Stroll 5K and Fun Run, but the main events take place May 1-2.
The South Carolina Strawberry Festival features music, children’s entertainment, food, vendors, rides, and of course, strawberries. Learn more about the festival here .
Whitewater Center River Jam
The Whitewater Center’s River Jam runs Thursday through Saturday from May through September, and features over 80 live outdoor concerts. The series features local and national touring bands highlighting Americana, Roots, and Soul/R&B sounds.
Check out the Whitewater Center website for the full list of events and live acts.
Bach & Beyond w/ Charlotte Symphony Orchestra
(Credit: Charlotte Symphony) “J.S. Bachs exhilarating Brandenburg Concertos frame an evening that bridges the Baroque spirit across centuries, paired with Handels glittering Water Music and contemporary reflections on the form by Caroline Shaw and Nancy Galbriath. Held in the historic Carolina Theatre, this concert brings the vitality and clarity of Baroque music into the present.”
This one-night-only event starts at 7:30 p.m. Visit the website for tickets .
SATURDAY, MAY 2 Hot Wheels Legends Tour
Calling all car lovers! The Hot Wheels Legends Tour, which celebrates the builders, visionaries, and people in the automotive world, and it’s coming to the Charlotte area! The family-friendly event features a mix of vehicles from across the state, Hot Wheels Garage of Legends life-size cars, and collectables that are only available on the tour.
The event will be held at the Walmart Supercenter on W. Roosevelt Blvd in Monroe from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m. The event is free and open to the public.
RiverFest in McAdenville
Join the celebration on the banks of the South Fork of the Catawba River! The Catawba Riverkeepers’ RiverFest offers a jam-packed day of live music, family-friendly activities, kayaking, local artisans and vendors, and so much more. The event takes place all day, from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 102 Main Street in downtown McAdenville, and from 6 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. at the Confluence in Cramerton, following the Floating Concert.
The event is free to join, and all proceeds benefit the Riverkeeper’s mission of preserving and protecting local waterways. Visit the website for more details .
Charlotte Margarita Festival
Sip and savor at the Charlotte Margarita Festival! This isn’t your average festival — it’s the “ultimate margarita tasting competition.” Join thousands of other margarita lovers for a flavor-packed showdown to find the best margarita in the city! Your tickets gets your ten 3.5 oz samples from Charlotte’s top bars and restaurants. The winning bar or restaurant walks away with $1,000 and ultimate bragging rights.
Visit the website for tickets .
Common Market Oakwold’s Eighth Anniversary and Renaissance Faire
Hear ye! Hear ye! Common Market Oakwold is celebrating its eighth year and is throwing a big medieval celebration! Spend your coin at the marketplace before indulging in medieval treats. Take part in a friendly sword fight and enjoy live performances.
The festivities begin at noon and proper regalia is encouraged. Special tokens may be handed out to the best-dressed.
LOOKING AHEAD Davidson Star Wars Movies Series
The Davidson Star Wars Summer Movie Series kicks off May 4 on National Star Wars Day. This free, family-friendly outdoor film series runs from May through October and features six of the iconic films from the Star Wars saga.
Bring your blankets, lawn chairs, and fellow Jedi (or Sith!) for a movie night under the stars. Each movie night will feature trivia and prizes. The series starts with Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope. Festivities begin at 7:15 p.m. at 130 S. Main Street, Town of Davidson Parking Lot between Summit and Ben & Jerry’s.
Truist Championship
We are just days away from the Truist Championship at Quail Hollow Club in Charlotte. One of eight events on the 2026 PGA TOUR schedule, the Truist Championship features one of the premier fields in golf, with past champions such as Tiger Woods, Max Homa (2), and Rickie Fowler. World No. 2 and four-time Truist Championship winner Rory McIlroy is set to return for the championship this year.
Tickets are now on sale .
